SITE is a strong underfollowed candidate for outdoor repair/remodel and landscape-contractor distribution because the market label is landscape supply, not consumer housing repair.

For housing repair/remodel, the chokepoint may be branch density, SKU breadth, contractor loyalty, specialty equipment availability, and networked service capacity rather than consumer-facing retail demand alone.

node: Housing repair/remodel contractor supply, specialty distributors, restoration products, equipment rental, and dealer networks
summary: Layer 1B expands the repair/remodel contractor-supply node using a two-lane funnel. Watsco is retained as the obvious HVAC-distribution reference anchor because it directly shows the contractor-network and replacement-demand model. The underfollowed lane surfaces SiteOne, Herc Holdings, and CSW Industrials as less obvious public-market mappings: landscape/irrigation contractor distribution, specialty rental including remediation/restoration and pro-contractor tools, and niche HVAC/plumbing/electrical contractor products. The working hypothesis is that housing repair/remodel value may accrue to local availability, contractor productivity, specialized SKUs, branch/dealer density, and service networks rather than only to consumer-facing home-improvement retailers.
